What to record before a service call

Useful observations help the team investigate.

01Assess02Plan03Document
01

Describe the change

Record whether the issue is slow flow, persistent odour, visible damage or a change in appearance. Identify the exact fixture and when the symptom began.

02

Gather the history

Find the last service date, installed component reference and products recently used. Note whether other fixtures on the same area are affected.

03

Arrange an assessment

Contact the responsible maintenance provider. Follow site procedures for taking an affected fixture out of use when necessary. Do not improvise chemical mixtures or plumbing repairs.
